mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 51 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Fireman's Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon.

City officials announced that road crack filling work will begin September 28, which may cause temporary lane closures on streets like South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street. Also, the Plan Commission will review several development projects on October 5, including new site plans at 201 South Main Street.

It is a busy couple of days for local fun. Today, test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Lake Lou-ee Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from September 5, police investigated reports of cheese slices left on windshields across several city streets, which was determined to be a social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel and opens today at 10:00 AM. Please note that today's flavor of the day is not available.
